title: Contagious Interview - One Interview Away From Infection
description: A sophisticated global campaign targets software developers with fake job interviews via a fraudulent company called AccuraSoftHire. The attackers use legitimate job platforms and verified LinkedIn profiles to lure candidates, delivering malicious npm packages disguised as Tailwind CSS plugins in take-home coding assignments. These packages deploy loaders that fetch additional malware payloads using blockchain dead drops. The campaign also distributes a fake camera driver from the company's career site to deliver malware. Linked to North Korean threat actors, this operation has infected tens of thousands of machines and caused significant cryptocurrency theft, including the Binance breach exceeding six billion dollars.
